purpose: Benign ordinary cruise tracking accuracy qualification in Cascade; no impact or evasion behavior.

task.initial_disturbances: Observed initial position and small attitude/rate offsets; no wind or sensor noise in first experiment.

learner.observations: NWU velocity3, FLU body rates3, body-to-world rotation9, as in existing generic flight experiments
learner.commands: normalized throttle and requested generalized surface angles [rad]

controller.development: Simulator-truth predictor on separate seed0 only; freeze controller before comparing learned predictor or evaluation trials.
controller.structure: One bounded short-horizon predictive controller for both models, with fixed positional lookahead and velocity/rate/attitude regularization. No learner settings tuned.

evaluation.diagnostic_arms: Oracle, learned, intermediate mixtures of their predictions, and prescribed prediction biases with fixed/alternating signs.
evaluation.timing: Fixed simulated time, offline computation; no real-time claim.
evaluation.oracle: Known physical model and equilibrium reset; causal replay of issued commands, no reading live hidden actuator states.
evaluation.failure: Divergent or nonfinite trials fail; unexecuted time intervals counted outside tolerance.
evaluation.limits: Artificial predictor mixtures and perturbations are sensitivity diagnostics, not physically identified models or generic accuracy bounds. Three trials per arm are not reliability certification.
